title: ever ASTRAL|Ruffle Sleeves Leaf Sequin Maxi Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This Ruffle Sleeves Leaf Sequin Maxi Bridesmaid Dress combines elegance with a touch of nature. The delicate leaf sequins shimmer as you move, adding a luxurious sparkle. The ruffled sleeves and flowing maxi length create a romantic silhouette, making it a perfect choice for bridesmaids looking for style and grace at weddings.

Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
